facts.business: Global Infratech & Finance Limited operates in the Finance & Investments segment and is developing a Biomass segment which has not yet commenced commercial operations.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to possible effects of the matter described in the Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph regarding accounting for the NCLT-approved Resolution Plan implementation.

key_risks: Going concern dependent on achieving profitable operations, generating sufficient cash flows, and continued financial support from new promoters
Complex accounting for NCLT-approved Resolution Plan involving significant management judgment in fair valuations
Valuation of equity securities with suspended trading or unavailable market quotations involves significant management judgment and estimates
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with KMPs and relatives include loans received from Chander Bhushan Bajaj (Rs 65.00 crore) and Mohit Bajaj (Rs 94.43 crore) during FY 2025-26, with outstanding balances of same amounts. Remuneration paid to KMPs including CS, CFOs, and Managing Director.
